scene.note: Thursday's kit sits at the top of kit_check.py, and your for loops do the same small job once for every radio, pitch or letter.

steps.note: Dougie knows how many radios are out tonight.
Under Task 1 a loop goes round once for each radio, with its number in the loop's own name.
One line per radio, from the first to the last, and none when no radio is out.
A crag lower goes down in pitches, and each pitch is longer than the one before.
Under Task 2 a total starts before the loop, and each round adds one pitch to it.
Once every pitch is added, Dougie knows how much rope to pack.
The new stretcher needs its label cut in stencils.
Under Task 3 a loop goes through the label one character at a time.
Each letter prints on its own line, in capitals, and the spaces are left out.
Every letter of the label needs a stencil of its own.
Under Task 4 a count starts before the loop and grows on the rounds that meet a letter.
Dougie knows how many stencils to cut, spaces not counted.
